reason: The plugin is best classified as a UI theme/layout utility because it adds a floating, bouncing DVD-style wordmark overlay to the web viewport with color cycling, as documented in the README, and its manifest indicates a web client plugin with no host logic.

summaries.zh: 该插件在 DSH Web 页面中通过覆盖层显示一个会漂移、碰撞边缘即反弹并变色的 DVD 字样动画效果。
summaries.en: This plugin adds a client-side DSH web overlay that animates a floating DVD-style wordmark bouncing across the viewport and changing color on each edge hit.

capabilities: Renders a continuous browser animation over the web app UI
Injects content into the shell overlay slot
Runs only in the web client runtime (no host-side processing described)
